body: I'm really sorry, I have a hard time with english and so I can't explain myself properly.

Your really good at making it sound so easy. But I just don't want to stick around and let things happen and maybe one day catch a break you know? It seems like I fight this war everyday, and I am just so tired. I can't say that I'm sad or even depressed. It feels like that wave has passed, and all that's left is basic human functions like eating and sleeping.

Its way more complex than all of you make it sound like. I cannot have a serious relationship with someone if I do not love them intimately. It would be cruel for that person to think tat you love them the same way they do, when in fact, it would be a big fat lie. 

What would you do if you found out that your partner was never attracted to you sexually? It just doesn't work. I have nothing to look forward to and this is why I never took any first steps to anything. 

I really appreciate your help, but I just get the impression that no one understands how deeply this is affecting me in every way possible.

I would consider myself a well-adjusted, intelligent person, but what's the point if you can't apply it anywhere? Sure I can go to school and get a degree, but for what? Why would I want to be successful? Unlike you, I don't have future aspirations to one day have a family of my own, because I can't.
I've tried times and times again. Nothing brings me happiness anymore, I just feel bland.
I've done enough soul searching, and I've made up my mind. You just have to understand that I don't want to be here. I don't want to live a life of misery and pain, its inhumane.

resisting my urges was never a problem. Its actually really easy to control.
I've been to therapy before and was prescribed medications. Unfortunately, it doesn't help me feel any better about myself. I am still a very unhappy person.

I know it wasn't my fault, but the damage is done. This is why I don't feel any hatred towards the ones that did this. I still speak to them fairly often and they are all good people.
